settings.heading: Sign in to your customer portal
settings.intro: Use your MrChocolate customer account to access your travel plans, ticket details, documents, and support information. This login experience is custom-branded now and ready for Salesforce-linked data later.
settings.login_copy: Only logged-in customers can access portal content. Sign in below if your account has already been created.
settings.recover_copy: Enter your email address and we will send you a password reset link.
settings.footnote: Phase 1 uses Shopify customer authentication. Salesforce can later become the source of customer account data without replacing this front-end login experience.
